description: Search the RottenAds offer catalog. Every filter is optional; results are ranked with offers converting now first. Payout is what RottenAds pays the publisher per conversion (or the RevShare %).

geo.description: Two-letter country code the offer must accept, e.g. US, UK, CA, DE

min_payout.description: Minimum fixed payout in the offer currency

model.description: Payout model: CPL, CPA, CPS or RevShare

query.description: Words to match in the offer name, vertical or restrictions, e.g. 'glp-1', 'auto insurance', 'roofing'

traffic.description: Traffic type the offer must accept: Email, SMS, Meta, TikTok, Social, Native, Display, Search, Push

vertical.description: Vertical name or part of it, e.g. Telehealth, Insurance, Finance, Home Services (see list_verticals)

name: search_offers
title: Search offers
